_comment: Help text for the ? buttons on the validation pages. Keys are sorted alphabetically. Each entry has a title and a text, both plain text (no HTML), ASCII only. Rebuild and deploy after an edit; npm test checks this file.

check_warnings.title: Check warnings
check_warnings.text: When on, validation also reports HED warnings, such as deprecated tags, in addition to errors.

dataset_root.title: Dataset root
dataset_root.text: Choose the top folder of a BIDS dataset, the one that holds dataset_description.json. The HED schema version is taken from HEDVersion in that file. The files are read in your browser and are not uploaded anywhere.

events_file.title: Tabular (.tsv) file
events_file.text: A BIDS-style tab-separated file whose first line holds the column names. HED comes from its HED column and from the JSON sidecar. The value n/a marks a missing value.

hed_string.title: HED string
hed_string.text: Enter one HED string to validate, for example Sensory-event, (Red, Large). The whole box is validated as a single string.

hed_version.title: HED schema version
hed_version.text: The HED schema version to validate against, for example 8.4.0. For library schemas give a list, such as score_2.2.0, lang_1.2.0 or [score_2.2.0, lang_1.2.0]. Versions not built into this page are downloaded from GitHub.

limit_errors.title: Limit errors
limit_errors.text: When on, the list shows one issue of each type, with a count of how many there are and in how many files. Download Errors still saves the full list.

sidecar_file.title: JSON sidecar
sidecar_file.text: A BIDS-style JSON sidecar that maps column values in the tabular file to HED annotation strings. HED definitions can be included in the sidecar to provide named, reusable tag groups.
